questions.q:
The charge accumulated on the capacitor connected in the following circuit is ______\mu C$.

(Given $C = 150\muF )
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Under the balanced condition, the capacitor will act as an open circuit.

The current \left({i}_{1}\right)$ through the $1Ω$ resistor is given by

$\begin{cases}{i}_{1} & = & \dfrac{10V}{1Ω + 2Ω} \\ & = & \dfrac{10}{3}A\end{cases}$

The current \left({i}_{2}\right)$ through the $6Ω$ resistor is given by

$\begin{cases}{i}_{2} & = & \dfrac{10V}{6Ω + 4Ω} \\ & = & 1A\end{cases}$

From the above diagram, it can be written that

${V}_{A} + {i}_{1} \times 1 - {i}_{2} \times 6 = {V}_{B} ⇒ {V}_{A} - {V}_{B} = 1 \times 6 - \dfrac{10}{3} \times 1 = \dfrac{8}{3}V$

Hence, the charge on the capacitor is given by

$\begin{cases}Q & = & C\left({V}_{A} - {V}_{B}\right) \\ & = & 150\mu F \times \dfrac{8}{3}V \\ & = & 400\mu C\end{cases}$

In the given circuit.${C}_{1} = 2\muF, {C}_{2} = 0 . 2\muF, {C}_{3} = 2\muF, {C}_{4} = 4\muF, {C}_{5} =$
$2\muF, {C}_{6} = 2\muF$. The charge stored on capacitor ${C}_{4}$~is~ ______~ ~$\muC$.
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
From the diagram of the circuit,& ${C}_{3}, {C}_{4}, {C}_{5}$~are in series, so the total capacitance is~

$\dfrac{1}{C '} = \dfrac{1}{2} + \dfrac{1}{4} + \dfrac{1}{2} ⇒ C ' = \dfrac{4}{5}\mu F$

$C ' \text{ and } {C}_{2}$~are parallel, the total capacitance is~

$C ' ' = \left(\dfrac{4}{5} + 0 . 2\right)\mu F = 1\mu F$

${C}_{1}, C ' ' , {C}_{6}$~are in series. So the equivalent capacitance is,

$\dfrac{1}{Ceq} = \dfrac{1}{2} + 1 + \dfrac{1}{2} ⇒ {C}_{eq} = 0 . 5\mu F$

Using~$Q = {C}_{eq}V$.

The charge through the battery,~$Q$~$= 10 \times \dfrac{1}{2} = 5\mu C$

~From the diagram above,

$Q ' = \dfrac{5\mu C \times 0 . 8}{0 . 8 + 0 . 2} = 4\mu C$

questions.q: A parallel plate capacitor with width $4$ cm, length $8$ cm~and separation between the plates of $4$ mm is connected to a battery of $20V$. A dielectric slab of dielectric constant $5$ having length $1$ cm, width $4$ cm and thickness $4$ mm is inserted between the plates of parallel plate capacitor. The electrostatic energy of this system will be _____~${ϵ}_{0}J$. (Where ${ϵ}_{0}$& is the permittivity of free space)
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
The figure below shows the parallel plate capacitor with dielectric slab placed in between the plates.

Now, the effective capacitance of the combination is&

${C}_{eff} = \left[\dfrac{{ε}_{0}\left(7 \times 4\right)}{\dfrac{4}{10}} + \dfrac{5{ε}_{0}\left(1 \times 4\right)}{\dfrac{4}{10}}\right] \times {10}^{- 2}$

$= \left[70{ε}_{0} + 50{ε}_{0}\right] \times {10}^{- 2} = 120{ε}_{0} \times {10}^{- 2}$

$⇒ {C}_{eff} = 1 . 2{ε}_{0}$

Electrostatics energy of this system is~$= \dfrac{1}{2}{C}_{eff}V^{2}$

$= \dfrac{1}{2}\left(1 . 2\right){ε}_{0}\left(20\right)\left(20\right) = 240{ε}_{0}$

questions.q: A parallel plate capacitor of capacitance $200\muF$ is connected to a battery of $200V .$~A dielectric slab of dielectric constant $2$ is now inserted into the space between plates of capacitor while the battery remain connected. The change in the electrostatic energy in the capacitor will be __________~$J .$
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Initially
$C = 200\muF$
${E}_{i} = \dfrac{1}{2}CV^{2} = \dfrac{1}{2} \times \left(200 \times {10}^{- 6}\right) \times \left(200\right)2$
Finally
$C^{'} = KC = 400\muF$
${E}_{f} = \dfrac{1}{2}C^{'}V^{2} = \dfrac{1}{2} \times \left(400 \times {10}^{- 6}\right) \times ( 200{)}^{2}$
$\Delta E = \dfrac{1}{2} \times \left[\left(400 - 200\right) \times {10}^{- 6}\right] \times 4 \times {10}^{4} = 4J$

questions.q: A time varying potential difference is applied between the plates of a parallel plate capacitor of capacitance $2.5 \mu \mathrm{~F}$. The dielectric constant of the medium between the capacitor plates is 1 . It produces an instantaneous displacement current of 0.25 mA in the intervening space between the capacitor plates, the magnitude of the rate of change of the potential difference will be _____ $\mathrm{Vs}^{-1}$.
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \frac{\mathrm{CdV}}{\mathrm{dt}}=\mathrm{I}_{\mathrm{d}} \\ & \frac{\mathrm{dV}}{\mathrm{dt}}=\frac{\mathrm{I}_{\mathrm{d}}}{\mathrm{C}} \\ & =\frac{0.25 \times 10^{-3}}{2.5 \times 10^{-6}} \\ & =100\end{aligned}$

questions.q:
A parallel plate capacitor with plate area& $A$~and plate separation~$d$~is filled with a dielectric material of dielectric constant~$K = 4 .$ The thickness of the dielectric material is~$x,$ where~$x < d .$

Let~${C}_{1}$~and~${C}_{2}$~be the capacitance of the system for~$x = \dfrac{1}{3}d$~and~$x = \dfrac{2d}{3},$~respectively. If~${C}_{1} = 2\mu F$,~the value of~${C}_{2}$~is _____~$\mu F .$
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
The formula to calculate the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor having thickness& $d$~and with a dielectric of thickness~$x$~between the plates is given by

$C = \dfrac{{ε}_{0}A}{\left(d - x\right) + \dfrac{x}{K}} . . . ( 1 )$

Substitute the values of the parameters for first case into equation (1) to obtain the capacitance.

$\begin{cases}{C}_{1} & = & \dfrac{{ε}_{0}A}{\dfrac{2d}{3} + \dfrac{\dfrac{d}{3}}{4}} \\ & = & \dfrac{4{ε}_{0}A}{3d} . . . ( 2 )\end{cases}$

Similarly, substitute the parameters into equation (1) for the second case to obtain the capacitance

$\begin{cases}{C}_{2} & = & \dfrac{{ε}_{0}A}{\dfrac{d}{3} + \dfrac{\dfrac{2d}{3}}{4}} \\ & = & \dfrac{4{ε}_{0}A}{2d} \\ & = & \dfrac{2{ε}_{0}A}{d} . . . ( 3 )\end{cases}$

Divide equation (3) by equation (2) to obtain the capacitance in the second case.

$\begin{cases}\dfrac{C2}{C1} & = & \dfrac{2{ε}_{0}Ad}{4{ε}_{0}A3d} \\ & = & \dfrac{3}{2} \\ {C}_{2} & = & \dfrac{3}{2}{C}_{1} . . . ( 4 )\end{cases}$

Substitute the value of the capacitance in the first case into equation (4) to obtain the value of the capacitance in the second case.

$\begin{cases}{C}_{2} & = & \dfrac{3}{2} \times 2\mu F \\ & = & 3\mu F\end{cases}$

questions.q:
The electric field between the two parallel plates of a capacitor of $1.5 \mu \mathrm{F}$ capacitance drops to one third of its initial value in $6.6 \mu \mathrm{s}$ when the plates are connected by a thin wire.
The resistance of this wire is _____\Omega$. (Given, $\log 3=1.1 )
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{E}=\frac{\mathrm{E}_0}{3} \Rightarrow \mathrm{V}=\frac{\mathrm{V}_0}{3} \\ & \frac{\mathrm{V}_0}{3}=\mathrm{V}_0 \mathrme^{-\frac{\mathrm{t}}{\tau}} \\ & \mathrm{t}=\tau \ell \mathrm{n} 3 \\ & 6.6 \times 10^{-6}=\mathrm{R}\left(1.5 \times 10^{-6}\right)(1.1) \\ & \mathrm{R}=\frac{6}{1.5}=4 \Omega\end{aligned}$

questions.q: A composite parallel plate capacitor is made up of two different dielectric materials with different thickness (${t}_{1}$~and ${t}_{2}$) as shown in figure. The two different dielectric material are separated by a conducting foil $F$. The voltage of the conducting foil is _____~$V$.
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Capacitance of each capacitor&

${C}_{1} = \dfrac{A3{ε}_{0}}{\dfrac{1}{2}} = 6A{ϵ}_{0}$~and~${C}_{2} = \dfrac{A4{ϵ}_{0}}{1} = 4A{ε}_{0}$

Here,~$A$~is~area of plate.

Equivalent capacitance is~

${C}_{eq} = \dfrac{{C}_{1}{C}_{2}}{{C}_{1} + {C}_{2}} = \dfrac{6A{ε}_{0} \times 4A{ε}_{0}}{6A{ε}_{0} + 4A{ε}_{0}} = \dfrac{24}{10}A{ϵ}_{0}$

Now, net charge stored is~${q}_{net} = {C}_{eq}\left(\Delta V\right) = \dfrac{24}{10}A{ε}_{0}\left(100\right) = 240A{ε}_{0}$

Potential drop across~${C}_{2}$~is~$\Delta{V}_{2} = \dfrac{240A{ε}_{0}}{4A{ε}_{0}} = 60V$

Thus, voltage~of the conducting foil is~${V}_{foil} = 60V$

questions.q: In an electrical circuit drawn below the amount of charge stored in the capacitor is _______ $\mu C .$
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
In steady state there will be no current in branch of capacitor, so no voltage drop across ${R}_{2} = 5Ω$

${I}_{2} = 0$

${I}_{1} = {I}_{3} = \dfrac{10}{4 + 6} = 1A$

${V}_{R3} = {V}_{c} + {V}_{R2} \left({V}_{R2} =0\right)$

$⇒ {I}_{3}{R}_{3} = {V}_{c}$

$⇒ {V}_{c} = 1 \times6 = 6$ volt

Therefore, charge on capacitor ${q}_{c} = C{V}_{c} = 10 \times6 = 60\mu C

$

questions.q: The equivalent capacitance between points $A$ and $B$ in below shown figure will be _____~$\muF$.
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Point& $3$~and~$4$~are at same potential, hence we can replace the capacitor with a wire.


Capacitors between points~$A$~and~$3$~are in parallel combination as shown above and their combined capacitance value will be $3C$.

This $3C$ capacitance is in series with $C$.
The equivalent capacitance of the system between points A and B is,~

questions.q: A parallel plate capacitor has plate area $100m^{2}$ and plate separation of $10m .$~The space between the plates is filled up to a thickness $5m$ with a material of dielectric constant of $10 .$ The resultant capacitance of the system is $xpF .$ The value of ${ε}_{0} = 8 . 85 \times {10}^{- 12}Fm^{- 1}$.~The value of $x$ to the nearest integer is ______.
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Here, Plate area$A = 100m^{2}$
Using, Capacity of parallel plate capacitor is,

$C = \dfrac{k{ε}_{0}A}{d}$; where~$d$~is separation between the plates and~$k$~is dielectric constant.

The capacitance with dielectric will be,
${C}_{1} = \dfrac{10{ϵ}_{0} ( 100 )}{5}$
$= 200{ϵ}_{0}$

The capacitance without dielectric or air will be,
${C}_{2} = \dfrac{{ϵ}_{0} ( 100 )}{5} = 20{ϵ}_{0}$
${C}_{1} \text{ and } {C}_{2}$ are in series so,

~${C}_{eqv. } = \dfrac{{C}_{1}{C}_{2}}{{C}_{1} + {C}_{2}}$

$= \dfrac{4000{ϵ}_{0}}{220}$
$= 160 . 9 \times {10}^{- 12} ≃ 161pF$

questions.q:
Two parallel plate capacitors ${C}_{1}$ and ${C}_{2}$ each having capacitance of $10\mu F$ are individually charged by a $100V$ D.C. source. Capacitor ${C}_{1}$ is kept connected to the source and a dielectric slab is inserted between it plates. Capacitor ${C}_{2}$ is disconnected from the source and then a dielectric slab is inserted in it. Afterwards the capacitor ${C}_{1}$ is also disconnected from the source and the two capacitors are finally connected in parallel combination. The common potential of the combination will be _____~$V$.

(Assuming Dielectric constant $= 10$)
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
As source is connected in the process therefore, additional charge will be provided. Therefore, charge on ${C}_{1} = K \left(CV\right)$.

Since source is disconnected, so its charge will remain the same. Then, charge on ${C}_{2} = CV$.

New capacitance in both cases will become,~$KC$.

When they are connected in parallel charge will be equally divided so charge on one capacitor is~$q = \left(\dfrac{K + 1}{2}\right)CV$.

So common potential,

$V^{'} = \dfrac{q}{KC} = \dfrac{K + 1}{2K}V = 55V.

$

questions.q: A capacitor of capacitance $C$ and potential $V$ has energy $E .$ It is connected to another capacitor of capacitance $2C$ and potential $2V$. Then the loss of energy is $\dfrac{x}{3}E$, where $x$ is _______.
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Given, $E = \dfrac{1}{2}CV^{2}$

Required energy loss

$= \dfrac{1}{2}\dfrac{{C}_{1}{C}_{2}}{{C}_{1} + {C}_{2}}\left({V}_{1} - {V}_{2}\right)2 = \dfrac{1}{2}\dfrac{C \times 2C}{C + 2C}\left(V - 2V\right)2$

$= \dfrac{2}{6}CV^{2} = \dfrac{2}{3} \cdot E$

$∴ x = 2$

questions.q: Space between the plates of a parallel plate capacitor of plate area $4 \mathrm{~cm}^2$ and separation of (d) 1.77 mm, is filled with uniform dielectric materials with dielectric constants (3 and 5) as shown in figure. Another capacitor of capacitance 7.5 pF is connected in parallel with it. The effective capacitance of this combination is ________ pF. \left(\right.$ Given \left.\varepsilon_0=8.85 \times 10^{-12} \mathrm{~F} / \mathrm{m}\right)$
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
$\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{C}_1=\frac{5 \times 4 \times 10^{-4} \times 8.85 \times 10^{-12}}{\frac{1.77}{2} \times 10^{-3}}=20 \mathrm{pF} \\ & \mathrm{C}_2=\frac{3 \times 4 \times 10^{-4} \times 8.85 \times 10^{-12}}{\frac{1.77}{2} \times 10^{-3}}=12 \mathrm{pF} \\ & \mathrm{C}_{\mathrm{eq}}=\frac{\mathrm{C}_1 \mathrm{C}_2}{\mathrm{C}_1+\mathrm{C}_2}=\frac{12 \times 20}{12+20}=7.5 \mathrm{pF}\end{aligned}$
Finally equivalent capacitance
\left(\mathrm{C}_{\mathrm{eq}}\right)_{\text {final }}=7.5+7.5=15 \mathrm{pF}

questions.q: A parallel plate capacitor with air between the plate has a capacitance of $15pF$. The separation between the plate becomes twice and the space between them is filled with a medium of dielectric constant $3 . 5$. Then the capacitance becomes $\dfrac{x}{4}pF$. The value of~$x$& is____.
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Capacitance of the parallel plate capacitor when air is present between the plates,& $C = \dfrac{{ε}_{0}A}{d} = 15pF$

Capacitance of the parallel plate capacitor when dielectric~is filled in between the plates,

~$C^{'} = \dfrac{k{ε}_{0}A}{d '} = \dfrac{3 . 5{ε}_{0}A}{2d} = \dfrac{3 . 5}{2} \times 15pF = \dfrac{105}{4}pF$

Therefore,~$x = 105$.

questions.q: As show in the figure, in steady state, the charge stored in the capacitor is _____× {10}^{- 6}C.
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
At the steady state, there will be no current through the capacitor. Therefore, potential difference across capacitor& ${V}_{C} = \dfrac{10}{R + r}R = \dfrac{10 \times 100}{100 + 10} = \dfrac{100}{11}V$

Charge on capacitor is~$q = C{V}_{C}$

$= \left(1 . 1 \times {10}^{- 6}\right)\left(\dfrac{100}{11}\right)

$⇒ q = 10\muC = 10 $\times {10}^{- 6}$C$.

$

questions.q:
A parallel plate capacitor whose capacitance $C$ is $14pF$ is charged by a battery to a potential difference $V = 12V$ between its plates. The charging battery is now disconnected and a porcelain plate with $k = 7$~is inserted between the plates, then the plate would oscillate back and forth between the plates with a constant mechanical energy of _______~$pJ .$

(Assume no friction)
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
${U}_{i} = \dfrac{1}{2} \times 14 \times 12 \times 12pJ \left(∵ U = $\dfrac{1}{2}$CV^{2}\right)$

$= 1008pJ$

${U}_{f} = $\dfrac{1008}{7}$pJ = 144pJ \left(∵ {C}_{m} = k{C}_{0}\right)$

Mechanical energy$= \Delta U$

$= 1008 - 144$

$= 864pJ$

questions.q: A parallel plate capacitor is made up of stair like structure with a plate area A of each stair and that is connected with a wire of length $b$, as shown in the figure. The capacitance of the arrangement is $\dfrac{x}{15}\dfrac{{ε}_{0}A}{b}$, The value of $x$ is _____ .

questions.solution:
Here the system can be considered as three capacitors in parallel.

So, net capacitance is&

$C = \dfrac{{ε}_{0}A}{5b} + \dfrac{{ε}_{0}A}{3b} + \dfrac{{ε}_{0}A}{b}$

$C = \dfrac{{ε}_{0}A}{b} \left[\dfrac{1}{5} + \dfrac{1}{3} + \dfrac{1}{1}\right]

$C = \dfrac{23{ε}_{0}A}{15b}$

$
